# Climate variable maps

This code creates 3 stacks of maps, one for each climate variable, at the same time steps as we used for the distribution maps. This helps us to understand the variables driving the changes in distribution.
It needs to be run in the same environment as the SDM scripts, after they have been run. 

```{r Climate variable maps}
# Climate variable maps with readable labels and fixed plotting


walk2(c("bio05", "bio06", "bio12"), 1:3, ~{
  var_name <- .x
  var_idx <- .y

  # Create a folder for the variable if it doesn't exist
  dir.create(paste0("C:/github/SNR_SDM/Results/Climate_Maps/", var_name), showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Loop over 41 time steps (40ka in 1ka timesteps starting at 0)
  walk(760:800, function(timestep) {
    year_bp <- time(climate_full[[1]])[timestep] - 1950  # Years before present

    # Extract climate data for the variable and timestep
    climate_snapshot <- climate_full[[var_idx]][[timestep]]
    names(climate_snapshot) <- var_name  # Assign name to layer

    # Convert raster to data frame for ggplot
    df <- as.data.frame(climate_snapshot, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Format label for title and legend
    label <- case_when(
      var_name == "bio05" ~ "Maximum Temperature",
      var_name == "bio06" ~ "Minimum Temperature",
      var_name == "bio12" ~ "Annual Precipitation"
    )

    # Plot
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = .data[[var_name]])) +
      geom_tile() +
      scale_fill_terrain_c(
        name = case_when(
          var_name == "bio05" ~ "Max\nTemp (°C)",
          var_name == "bio06" ~ "Min\nTemp (°C)",
          var_name == "bio12" ~ "Annual\nRainfall (mm)"
        ),
        oob = scales::squish
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(label, " – ", year_bp, " years BP"),
        x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
      ) +
      coord_fixed() +
      theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
      )

    # Save plot
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("C:/github/SNR_SDM/Results/Climate_Maps/", var_name, "/", var_name, "_map_", year_bp, ".png"),
      plot = p,
      width = 7, height = 7
    )
  })
})

# Save metadata explainer in the Climate_Maps folder

assign("plot_path", plot_path, envir = .GlobalEnv)

```
